notes: PHASE-000 remains complete and PHASE-001 development is active. WU-002 remains in progress because its acceptance criterion is not yet satisfied: approved desktop calling applications have not consumed processed/bypass audio through a VSN virtual microphone installed on a controlled Windows test machine. Its PortCls/WaveRT scheduler, capture-only INF/test package, InfVerif/Inf2Cat validation and installed-runtime smoke harness remain CI verified, but hosted CI is intentionally verification_required for a real installed endpoint; controlled endpoint enumeration, calling-app routing, hardware latency/jitter and release-signing evidence remain pending. WU-014 remains in progress and has advanced beyond the prior reconciliation: PR #56 merged a fail-closed GET /v1/workspaces/:organizationId/bootstrap HTTP binding using provider-neutral trusted-principal and membership resolvers whose default application wiring rejects requests until verified adapters are supplied; PR #58 merged a strict same-origin web bootstrap client after Web Validation passed TypeScript checks, executable contract tests, production build and Chromium responsive/E2E checks. The client uses credentials include, does not fabricate Authorization headers, validates exact tenant-bound response shape and fails closed on authentication, authorization, transport, malformed-response and cross-tenant conditions. WU-014 still has no selected/verified production identity adapter, durable organization-membership persistence, trusted browser organization/session source or populated workspace repositories, so no authenticated production workspace claim is made. WU-016 remains in progress and has also advanced: PR #57 merged a deterministic content-safe routing operational snapshot; PR #59 merged a precision-safe cross-service/browser export contract that preserves potentially 64-bit values as canonical decimal strings rather than unsafe JSON numbers; PR #60 merged a bounded provider-neutral alert sink boundary with per-sink batch isolation, failure continuation, panic containment, bounded fan-out and content-safe dispatch reports that discard adapter error text. WU-016 still has no real external alert-delivery adapter, full admin analytics surface, durable usage/billing reconciliation or production provider activation, so it remains in progress. WU-002, WU-014 and WU-016 remain the three evidence-backed in-progress work units. Multi-agent execution remains in degraded single-runtime mode because config/ai/agent-catalog.json has no verified attachable agents and config/coordination/supervisor-state.json has no live Supervisor. Eleven bounded workstreams and a max_parallel_agents budget of 11 are staged, but they must not be represented as active workers until real identities are attached and leased through the coordination protocol.
